notes.title: Version 0.1.3.211 - Beanies, C96 pistol, tattoos, new animations and more!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello heroes!

As we're working on the next big update and the Halloween Heroes event we have another in between update for you today featuring some new cool things such as 

[b]beanies, new tattoos, a new weapon and character movement animation improvements![/b]

The new beanies were made by community member [b]Reebalt[/b] ːsteamhappyː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/a8706786f3e8fed2e43d1098555f40084d246caa.png[/img]

[b]Valor Village fishing boat[/b]

We've also spiced up VV with a fishing boat near the docks. We're also working on smaller boats to place in the wooden dock section. The boats will also be part of the new map we're working on. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/cb9de68549237c0b3870d162f03f35cce6f04add.jpg[/img]

[/p][h3]Patch notes:[/h3][p]
[b]Animations:[/b]
-added upper body leading motion for a less static and more dynamic/realistic upper/lower body gameplay feel
-added in place turning animation (no more floating turn)
-added no weapon pose to hero in customization menu (weapon now only shown when browsing weapon skins)
-tweaked character proportions a bit (less bee hips, more as it should be)

[b]New weapon:[/b] 
-added Mauser C96 weapon as Axis counterpart for the .357 Magnum  

[b]Tweaks:[/b]
-increased custom camera position limits (higher and more towards middle for a 100% centered BFH-like camera position) - You may have to readjust your camera position

[b]Cosmetics:[/b]
-added beanies in several colours
-added several new tattoos (snakes, sailing ships, heart, ...)
-added black glasses
-tweaked some more cosmetic colours (grey balaclava, grey beret, ...)
-smoke weapon skin darkened and renamed to Dunkelgrau

[b]Visuals:[/b]
-added very subtle yellow colour tint for a slightly warmer feel (experimental)

[b]Conquest:[/b]
-changed kill ticket decrease amount from 2 -> 1
-changed flag ticket decrease amount from 1 -> 2

[i](these changes were made to put more emphasis and reward on capturing objectives, this should also normalise match lengths a bit more as well as give teams more comeback power)[/i]

[b]Valor Village:[/b]
-added fishing boat to the dock section

[b]Balance[/b]
-increased clap impact damage from 5-50 -> 10-75

[b]Other:[/b]
-added credits button and page to main menu[/p]

Cheers!

notes.title: Version 0.1.3.060 - FPS and network Optimizations and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello heroes! :D

Been working on some serious optimizations that should increase FPS quite significantly as well as a lot of network optimizations that should make the game use less bandwith and therefor have a smoother overall multiplayer experience.

We're working on a lot more bug fixes such as a fix for the coin stacking, plane swap board, lingering backseat gun, ... Except a few more hotfix and bug fix updates soon. :)

Cheers!

-big network optimization pass
-big FPS optimization pass
-tank reload bar no longer flashes red when reloading (bug fix)
-fixed incorrect host determination after traveling to a new map (votekick / ban menu bugs)
-fixed planes slowing down when flying fast close to the ground
-fixed national skin and face not working in-game
-dynamic/custom crosshair now also fades a little while reloading like the classic crosshair
-vehicle usernames should now be much more reliably rendered (planes and tanks sometimes not showing username tag bug fix)
-TNT stuck to a player should no longer block the player's bullets
-attack plane rockets should now be much more responsive and reliable in damage output

-game should now take focus on launch
-further improved plane transform smoothness
-further improved tank transform smoothness

-changed it so that launch inflicter always gets the kill now when target lands in the water
-water kills should now show in kill-feed
-reworked active skill progress bar a bit to be better visible and added skill ending animation
-fixed Overcharge effect not staying as long as the skill is active which caused confusion about the skill still being active or not
-fixed screen shake happening on server host whenever an AI tank collides with a character
-AI tanks should no longer get stuck on other AI characters
-cursor should no longer disappear after map load on hosts

notes.title: Week 1 Update: We’ve Got A Brand New Map For You!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Soldiers,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a week since the start of our first offensive, and we’ve got a little surprise to keep morale high…
[/p][h3][b][u]Introducing: Barricade Bridge[/u][/b][/h3][p]Barricade Bridge is a brand-new [i]Capture & Hold[/i] map set on a mighty steel bridge! Hovering over a cascading river, your aim is to fight your way through a confined space and gain control over the bridge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/25a59de0c3f907a2b95cc15bfd8a63fba4bb7efa.png"][/img]One perfectly timed clap and you can catapult your enemies into the current, one misstep and you’re the one going for a swim. It’s a high-octane, high-stakes battle for control. And it’s loads of fun.[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Tweaks to the Server System[/u][/b][/h3][p]
We’ve noticed that a lot of you have been running into issues with our server browser, specifically when it comes to finding games in other regions. That’s why we’ve implemented a brand-new subsystem allowing for non-region locked servers and ping measurements. You’ll finally be able to play with your friends in different parts of the world and freely choose the server that best suits your needs! 

Headshotting your friend on the other side of the globe sounds fun, doesn’t it? [/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]A Small Thank You[/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We decided to drop an update so soon after release [b]as a small thank you note to the community[/b]. It’s been one week since we’ve released into Early Access and your reaction has been overwhelming! From the frenzied discussions on Discord, to the huge amount of reviews you guys left on our store page, we want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/311bf2cde873db7afe9eb1bc71bf84244f3713fb.png"][/img]Don’t worry, we’ve already celebrated with some Belgian beers. But we also wanted you to have something to celebrate with, so we hope you’ll enjoy the new map! 
[/p][p]That’s it for now, soldiers! We’re steadily cranking out bug fixes & improvements, so if you find anything that’s FUBAR, hop on our Discord or on Steam Discussions to let us know. And of course, we’re also sneakily grinding away at our next big Roadmap update… [b]
[/b][/p][p][b][u]Patch notes:[/u][/b] [/p][list][*][p]New map: Barricade Bridge (Capture & Hold)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New online subsystem which allows for global non region locked servers and ping measurements[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked some networking setting that smooth out gameplay a bit more (might still need more tweaks)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed motorcycle out of combat and death from exiting bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential similar issue with tanks and planes[/p][/*][*][p]Increased launch force on enemies from all types of explosions with 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bots sometimes still showing a golden name in scoreboard[/p][/*][/list][p]
We can’t wait to share all the cool stuff we’re working on! 
[b]Fancy Cat Interactive[/b][/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504090/Heroes_of_Valor/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p]

notes.title: Chaotic new multiplayer shooter is a WW2 version of Team Fortress 2
notes.notes:
WWII was one of the deadliest human conflicts in history. The scale of the devastation is mind-boggling to consider. But these grave facts have not prevented generations of comedians, artists, and game developers from getting silly with it. Heroes of Valor is a more absurd take on the chaos of Battlefield: 1942. It's a class-based team shooter in the spirit of Team Fortress 2. The game recently launched into early access and currently has a "very positive" rating on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Version 0.1.3.019 - Quickplay, bug fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
Hello Heroes! :D

We hope you are having a good time with the game. We've heard that some of you find it hard to navigate the server browser and find a good game. So we made a Quick Play system that should (hopefully) put you in a suitable game with some players and decent ping. It's still experimental, so it might not work too great yet. We'll keep tweaking it though.

We've also got some other bug fixes and tweaks for you in this one. :)

Cheers!

[b]New:[/b]
-experimental Quick Play system
-stats should now be saved when going back to the main menu (kick/ban of any kind and manual leave) (losing connection does not save stats yet)

[b]Bug fixes and improvements:[/b]
-added local character customization pre-loading to fix visible customization loading on high ping servers
-fixed votekick menu entry UI
-fixed plane machinegun sound not adhering to volume control
-fixed camera offset when spawning on high ping servers
-motorcycle death from exiting should be fixed (if not, let us know in the discord with further info and or recorded footage)

[b]Balance tweaks:[/b]
-reduced trooper self heal from Field Medic skill from 45-65 (1-3 surrounding players) to 35-55
-increased knife attack speed from 0.65 cooldown -> 0.6
-increased scoped semi auto reload speed from 2.5 reload time -> 2.4
-slightly decreased semi auto firerate from 0.322 cooldown -> 0.325
-increased short range MG firerate from 0.085 cooldown -> 0.081
-increased mid range MG firerate from 0.105 cooldown -> 0.102
-increased far range MG firerate from 0.165 cooldown -> 0.162

notes.title: Join the Fight: Heroes of Valor is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h2]Fall in, soldier! It’s time to lace up your combat boots and put on your dinosaur mask. Welcome to war!   

[b]Heroes of Valor is [u][i]OUT NOW[/i][/u] in Early Access![/b]  [/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="5sV1qLXbR3E;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
You can now pick up Heroes of Valor for [b]€14,79/$14,99/£12,79, with a 10% launch discount! And [/b]if [b]you wanna support the development[/b] of this game a little more, you can grab the Heroes of Valor Decorated Supporter Pack for $7.99/£6.69/€7.79! 

If you pick up the game, make sure to [b]leave a review![/b] It's the easiest way for you to support us, by helping us get the game in front of as many eyes as possible. 
[/p][h3][u][b]Roadmap[/b][/u][/h3][p]We’ve decided to release Heroes of Valor in Early Access, because [b]we felt like there was a lot of unique, exciting content that we still wanted to add to the game[/b] – and we felt like doing alongside you would be a lot more fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/c71263b5369c9a421b01159722b510e19cc983e8.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re sure that [b]Early Access content [/b]has been a burning question on everybody’s mind, so we’ve put together this roadmap so you can see what brand-new stuff you can expect as we keep working on the game! [b]From new classes, to war bonds, to seasonal events,[/b] we have a lot of big guns in the pipeline, and we think you’ll enjoy them as much as we do. We know this is [b]not the most precise roadmap[/b] out there, but we wanna keep the element of surprise on our side. As we get closer to each phase, we’ll reveal more about what’s gonna be in each update. So keep your eyes peeled! 
[/p][h3][b][u]But like… what IS Heroes of Valor?[/u][/b][/h3][p]Right, we forgot that some of you are new here. Let me recap: [b]Heroes of Valor is a chaotic, stylized WWII shooter.[/b] We’re launching with four maps, three classes, and a boatload of weapons and cosmetics. Customize your Hero, pick your team, and join the fray! [/p][p]Flying bullets, roaring tanks, and planes swarm everywhere. In Heroes of Valor, there's no room for hesitation. Blow your enemies to smithereens and take home the win for your platoon. 
[/p][p][b]Got it? Good. See you on the front.[/b] [/p][p]Fancy Cat Interactive
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504090/Heroes_of_Valor/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Heroes of Valor is dropping into Early Access on June 12th!
notes.notes:
[b]Sound the alarms, soldiers![/b]

[h4]Heroes of Valor [b]launches into Early Access on June 12th[/b]![/h4]

The time has come. No more “soon.” No more cryptic hints. [b]We’ve circled a date on the calendar, underlined it twice, and probably shouted it in our sleep![/b] June 12th is the day Heroes of Valor officially enters Early Access.

[h4][b]🎬 Watch the brand-new launch trailer right here:[/b][/h4]

notes.title: A Small Thank You Note
notes.notes:
[h3]Listen up, soldiers![/h3]

It’s almost been a month since we announced our publishing deal, and we still can’t quite believe how much has happened since. [b]We’ve gained 25.000 Wishlists and our server browser is busier than ever – seriously, we had to add a scrolling feature![/b]

Reading everyone’s excited, nostalgia-tinged comments has been really heartwarming! We had one particular goal with Heroes of Valor: [b]to bring back some of our core gaming memories, playing a type of shooter that just doesn’t seem to be around anymore (if you know you know).[/b] We wanted to recapture that old school feeling, and we’re so excited that that resonated with all of you.

[h4]Thanks to everyone who’s wishlisted, joined the playtest, and chatted on the Discord! We’re cooking up a lot of exciting stuff, and we’re so hyped to be able to share it with all of you soon.[/h4]

[b]A bunch of creators from all over the world[/b] also covered our little passion project! For the past few weeks, we’ve been watching video after video, and it’s been an absolute thrill to see other people run around the playground we’ve created. From creators we’ve been watching for years, to new discoveries, we wanna thank everyone who’s covered the game so far!

notes.title: We Have A Publisher Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Listen up, soldiers![/h3]

We have some [b]brand-new recruits joining our playtest[/b] and we need you to show them the ropes! 

Some of them have just gotten the call to arms, and are [b]wet behind their ears[/b]. These little puppy dogs haven’t experienced [b]the thrills of infantry shootouts, the bundled might of a tank standoff, or the deafening howl of a dogfight[/b]. Whether Axis or Allies, they’re lost souls! Cover them on the fields during a Coastal Conflict, and protect them from those nefarious Recons in Valor Village. This war isn’t lost yet. 

[h5]To all our new recruits: Welcome to Heroes of Valor. Please don’t embarrass yourselves. And if you do, make it look cool at least. [/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/831dd993f14bc7d66038f84520582c53a61018fc.png[/img]

Leading up to the full release of Heroes of Valor, we’ve [b]decided to join forces with our friends at Iceberg Interactive[/b]! Making a game is hard, especially for a two-man team. We felt like it has become increasingly tough to balance working on the game and getting it in front of as many eyes as possible. And that’s why we decided to partner with Iceberg Interactive! They’ll be able to [b]focus on the marketing side of things[/b], while we can keep coming up with crazy ideas for our little shooter!

We’ve worked with Iceberg in the past — they published Blazing Sails, the pirate Battle Royale we worked on at Get Up Games — and we think this collaboration is going to be a fruitful one! [b]We’ll be spitballing ideas together, collaborating on cool content, and making sure the game gets to hit with the full impact of a rocket launcher! [/b]

Ultimately, what you’ll get is a bunch of new friends to play with, or, a bunch of new enemies to tank smash. We’re very excited for what’s to come!

[b]See you on the battlefields,[/b]

Fancy Cat Interactive
